correctness.rationale: Uniform local helper choices within blocks separated by gaps ≥4 realize arbitrary labels after greedy extension. For p long gaps and q short gaps, the coefficient of u^(k−p−q)v^q in (1/(1−u)+v/(1−u)^2)^p gives the interval types. Stars and bars allocates the long-gap excesses. Marking a long gap and then a support vertex gives n/p without any assumption of asymmetric patterns. The cases with no long gaps contribute only the all-three or unique-two patterns.
residual_risks: Finite checks only corroborate the general proof.
